description: Display of 1no internally illuminated digital advertisement screen measuring 7.5 metres (height) x 5 metres (width) and 1no internally illuminated digital logo box measuring 0.65 metres (height) x 3.45 metres (width) to each of the western and eastern elevations of the tower structure to replace the existing screens and logo boxes; re-cladding of external elevations of the tower structure (Amended description).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The period of this consent shall expire 5 years from the date of this notice. 

Condition required to be imposed by the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 1992.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the approved plans and drawings listed in this decision notice, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission.

o 12723 PA 03 Proposed Site Plan 
o 12723 PA 04 Existing and Proposed Elevations West 
o 12723 PA 05 Existing and Proposed Elevations East 
o 12723 PA 06 Existing and Proposed Elevations South 
o 12723 PA 07 Existing and Proposed Elevations North 
o 12723 PA 08 Proposal CGI 
o 12723 PA 09 Design & Material Specification

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The illumination of the sign(s)advertisement(s) shall comply with the recommendations of the Institution of Lighting Professionals in the 'Guidance Note 01/20: Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light'. and the 'Professional Lighting Guide No 5, 2023 - Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements. 

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by artificial lighting, in accordance with Policies CC12 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - The proposed advertising panels shall operate at an illumination level no greater than 300cd/m2 between dusk and dawn, consistent with the guidance set out in the Institute of Lighting Professionals (ILP) publication: "The Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements including digital displays" (PLG05/23, 2023).  

For lighting during the day, either no lighting, or maximum lighting levels shall be set to accord with night time maximums, or controlled so they comply with the guidance approach to ambient lighting. 

To ensure that the proposals would not have an unacceptable impact upon road safety and is in accordance with Local Plan (2018) Policies T1, T6 and DC9 and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 5 - The sign(s)advertisement(s) hereby approved shall not display sequential advertisements that change more frequently than every 10 seconds and the change between advertisements will take place over a period no greater than one second, and the advertisements shall not include features/equipment which would allow interactive messages/advertisements to be displayed.  

In the interests of public and highway safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Local Plan (2018) Policies T1, T6 and DC9 and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 6 - Any illumination shall not be intermittent and there shall be no changing light patterns. There shall be no special effects or any moving, or apparently moving, images, (including noise, smell, smoke, animation, exposed cold cathode tubing, flashing, scrolling, three dimensional, intermittent or video elements) of any kind during the time that any message is displayed. 

In the interests of public and highway safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Local Plan (2018) Policies T1, T6 and DC9 and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 7 - The screens shall be designed so that, in the event of breakdown or malfunction, it shall automatically power-off and default to a blank or black screen to prevent flashing error messages being displayed, and it shall be so maintained. The display shall be switched off within 24 hours and shall remain off until repaired. 

In the interests of public safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, and to ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by changing light patterns from artificial lighting, in accordance with Policies T1, T6, CC12 and DC9 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 8 - Details (including physical samples and colours) of external metal cladding materials to the advertisement structure shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council prior to the display of the advertisement hereby approved. The development must be completed in accordance with the details as approved and it shall be permanently retained thereafter. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to preserve the character and appearance of the Conservation Area in accordance with Policies DC8 and DC9 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 9 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until the following documents (in consultation with London Underground), have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority: 

1. Detailed design (including temporary works design) and Risk Assessment Method Statement on the use of tall plant (e.g. Hiab's, mobile cranes) and scaffold, ensuring that no oversailing of adjoining London Underground land and infrastructure and to eliminate the risk of collapse of temporary works and scaffolding. 

2. Detailed design and Risk Assessment Method Statement on mounting the signage. 

3. Site specific Risk Assessment and Method Statements (RAMS) to be agreed with TfL Engineering for cladding, craneage etc.) which TfL may deem to be a risk to LU. The RAMS should be issued a minimum of 6 weeks prior to the activity commencing. 

The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition required by London Underground Infrastructure Protection (LUIP) to ensure that the development does not impact on existing London Underground/DLR transport infrastructure, in accordance with the London Plan (2021) Policy T3 and Sustainable Transport Walking and Cycling London Plan Guidance (2022), and Policies T1, T6 and DC9 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 10 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until a Installation Strategy (in consultation with Transport for London), has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. This should include details of construction logistics (vehicle access arrangements, material storage, and construction methodologies) in connection with the installation of the advertisements.

Please note: The footway and carriageway of A4 Hammersmith Flyover should not be blocked during the installation works. Temporary obstructions during the development works should be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic along the A4. All vehicles should only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.

The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition required by Transport for London (TfL) to ensure that the installation works do not impact upon the performance/and or safety of the A4 Hammersmith Flyover, which forms part of the Transport for London Road Network (TLRN), in accordance with Policies T1, T6 and DC9 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
